specification: Clarified bool/nonfinite validation, numeric float representation and Python rounding.
implementation: Enforced bool/nonfinite validation promised by the approved specification and removed unnecessary executable __main__ demonstration code.
tests: Corrected module import to the actual _code module, strengthened exact float type and added small-distance rounding and zero return-type assertions. Other numeric expectations independently checked.
acceptance: Expanded three valid examples to eleven independently calculated cases, adding fractional distances and invalid inputs. Reload/restart queries use 25km and 12km, neither included in the acceptance cases.
